تهروا (form I)
# تَهِرُّوا (tahirrū) /ta.hir.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of هَرَّ (harra)
# تُهَرُّوا (tuharrū) /tu.har.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
